| --- | --- |

## Ports

| Name | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `AssignmentOperationStore` | append assignment mutation records |
| `AssignmentOperationLoader` | load durable records for replay |
| `AssignmentQueueReader` | read queued assignments by agent |
| `AssignmentClaimer` | atomically claim next assignment |
| `AssignmentActiveLeaseStore` | load and refresh active assignment leases |
| `AssignmentProjectionReader` | load assignment read projections |

## Records

| Name | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `AssignmentOperationRecord` | append-only mutation plus emitted task events |
| `AssignmentProjection` | durable assignment read projection |
| `AssignmentActiveLease` | active assignment lease snapshot |
| `AssignmentClaimResult` | claim outcome plus operation evidence |

## Replay Rules

| Rule | Kind | Statement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `validate-before-apply` | replay | validate every operation record before applying it |
| `stable-replay-order` | replay | order by last event sequence, recorded_at, then operation_id |
| `dedupe-task-events` | replay | dedupe events by task_id and sequence |
| `cross-task-same-seq` | replay | keep same sequence events when task_id differs |
| `track-next-sequences` | replay | rebuild next_event_seq and next_assignment_seq |
| `sort-replayed-events` | replay | sort task event histories by sequence |
| `rebuild-current-assignment` | index | rebuild task current_assignment_id from newest assignment ordering |
| `rebuild-agent-index` | index | rebuild agent assignment lists in assignment creation order |
